name: Indiana
status_why: The Election Division's JSON files answered scripts.
system: State-built election night reporting from the Indiana Election Division (enr.indianavoters.in.gov, JSON files behind a static page)

election.nov3_id: the site switches to Nov 3 in place

feeds.address: https://enr.indianavoters.in.gov/site/data/settings.json (CurrentElection, ElectionType, Certified, VersionType, IntervalInMinutes, parties) -> statewideElectionsC_<VersionType>.json (office categories by heading Federal/State/Local) -> OffCatC_<category id>_<VersionType>.json (StatewideSummary races and Regions per county with RegionSummary)
feeds.note: 200 on 2026-10-09 (Cloudflare in front, no challenge); files start with a UTF-8 BOM.

feeds.address: category 'US Representative' (and US Senator in Senate years)

Local categories: Clerk of the Circuit Court, County Auditor/Recorder/Treasurer/Sheriff/Coroner/Surveyor/Assessor, County Commissioner, County Council Member, Township Assessor/Trustee/Board Member, Mayor, City Clerk, City Court Judge, City/Town Council, Town Clerk-Treasurer, Constable
feeds.note: Seen in the May 5 primary's category list.

races_in_feed: Federal, State (Legislature, circuit and superior judges, prosecutors) and Local (county, township, city, town) all in one system; school board races too in general elections (not checked).
local: Not needed for totals; Marion County also posts its own.
how_counted: Counties report through the night; the state's site refreshes about every two minutes.
count_order: No vote-type split: results by county.
vote_types: Not seen: results are by county (Regions keyed by county FIPS).

certify.body: the Governor, through the Indiana Election Division
certify.rule: Commissions for state offices are prepared by noon on the first Tuesday in December (Ind. Code 3-12-5-8); county clerks certify by noon on the second Monday after the election (3-12-5-6).
certify.local_rule: Second Monday after the election (Ind. Code 3-12-5-6).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: Copy the May 5, 2026 primary's JSON before the site switches (N9).
scout_plan: Live-readable. Poll settings.json every 2 minutes (its own stated interval); when WriteTime or VersionCode changes, fetch the office-category files for federal, state and local races. County-level only, which suits the map. Save a copy of the primary's JSON now to rehearse with, since the site will be overwritten by the general election.
to_do: Copy the primary's files before the site switches to Nov 3.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
